title: Design System: Elite Kitchens Lead OS

title.purpose: Customer name in the conversation header.

shadows.name: profile-overlay
shadows.purpose: Profile overlay from 900px through 1279px; removed on phones.

motion.name: control-background
motion.purpose: Buttons, icon controls, rail destinations and conversation rows only when prefers-reduced-motion is no-preference.

extensions.tonalRampPurpose: Generated OKLCH strips for palette inspection only. They are not implemented application tokens.

source.extraction: Source-based extraction of the implemented light interface; previews use synthetic customer text.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Compact primary button with visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:6px;min-height:40px;padding:9px 15px;font:600 14px/1.4 var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif);background:var(--ink, #252724);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;}.ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#42483d}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #465c45);outline-offset:3px}.ds-btn-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}@media(max-width:899px){.ds-btn-primary{min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-btn-primary{transition:background-color 150ms ease-out}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Compact secondary button with visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:6px;min-height:40px;padding:9px 15px;font:600 14px/1.4 var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif);background:var(--hover, #f0f1eb);color:var(--ink, #252724);cursor:pointer;}.ds-btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled){background:#e5e7df}.ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #465c45);outline-offset:3px}.ds-btn-ghost:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}@media(max-width:899px){.ds-btn-ghost{min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-btn-ghost{transition:background-color 150ms ease-out}}

components.name: Destructive confirmation
components.description: Filled variant for a confirmed destructive action. The profile entry action uses unfilled red text.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:6px;min-height:40px;padding:9px 15px;font:600 14px/1.4 var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif);background:var(--err, #a52d28);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;}.ds-btn-danger:hover:not(:disabled){background:#862520}.ds-btn-danger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #465c45);outline-offset:3px}.ds-btn-danger:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}@media(max-width:899px){.ds-btn-danger{min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-btn-danger{transition:background-color 150ms ease-out}}

components.name: Link button
components.description: Compact link button with visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:6px;min-height:40px;padding:9px 15px;font:600 14px/1.4 var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif);background:none;color:var(--muted, #686b64);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;}.ds-btn-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #465c45);outline-offset:3px}.ds-btn-link:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}@media(max-width:899px){.ds-btn-link{min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-btn-link{transition:background-color 150ms ease-out}}

components.name: Profile field
components.description: Compact labeled customer field with hover, focus and invalid states.
components.css: .ds-field{display:block;font:400 12px/1.5 var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif);color:var(--muted, #686b64);margin-bottom:12px}.ds-field input{display:block;width:100%;margin-top:4px;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid #e1e4db;border-radius:4px;background:#fafbf7;font:400 14px/1.4 var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif);color:var(--ink, #252724);min-height:38px}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:#bdc5b6}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #465c45);outline-offset:3px}.ds-field input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--err, #a52d28)}@media(max-width:899px){.ds-field input{font-size:16px}}

components.name: Active navigation
components.description: Pale rail with an understated active Inbox destination.
components.html: Inbox
components.css: .ds-rail{background:var(--nav, #f3f3ef);padding:14px;width:196px}.ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 12px;border:0;border-radius:6px;text-decoration:none;background:#e6e8e0;color:var(--ink, #252724);font:600 14px/1.5 var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-nav svg{flex:none}.ds-nav:hover{background:#e6e8e0}.ds-nav:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #465c45);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-nav{transition:background-color 150ms ease-out}}

components.name: Inbox count
components.description: Non-interactive compact counter used beside the Inbox heading.
components.css: .ds-count{display:inline;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:5px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--selected, #e9ece4);color:var(--accent, #465c45);font:600 12px/1.3 var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif);letter-spacing:0}

components.name: Selected conversation
components.description: Synthetic selected unread conversation showing name, preview and time hierarchy.
components.html:
SC
Sample customer10:42
Thank you, I will send the plans.
components.css: .ds-conv{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:15px 12px;margin:2px 0;border-radius:6px;background:var(--selected, #e9ece4);color:var(--ink, #252724);font:400 15px/1.5 var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-conv:hover{background:var(--selected, #e9ece4)}.ds-conv:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #465c45);outline-offset:3px}.ds-avatar{width:38px;height:38px;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:#dce2d3;color:#45543c;font-size:13px;font-weight:500}.ds-conv-body{min-width:0;flex:1}.ds-conv-top{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px}.ds-name{font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.ds-time{flex:none;font-size:11px;color:var(--accent, #465c45);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-preview{font-size:13px;font-weight:550;margin-top:4px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}@media(max-width:899px){.ds-conv{padding:16px 12px}.ds-name{font-size:16px}.ds-preview{font-size:14px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-conv{transition:background-color 150ms ease-out}}

components.name: Outgoing message
components.description: A quiet message surface with a reduced bottom corner and read receipt; synthetic content.
components.html:
Thanks, we have received your plans.
10:43✓✓
components.css: .ds-message{max-width:min(82%,560px);padding:9px 12px 6px;border-radius:8px;border-bottom-right-radius:2px;background:var(--out, #e9ede3);color:var(--out-ink, #252d25);font:400 15px/1.5 var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif);white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:6px;margin-top:5px;font-size:11px;color:#5f675a;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-read{color:var(--ok, #267393);white-space:nowrap}@media(max-width:899px){.ds-message{max-width:88%}}

components.name: Customer section tabs
components.description: Details, Media and Documents with a quiet underline. Static style preview; application JavaScript owns tab switching.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;padding:0 18px;gap:17px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #e6e7e1)}.ds-tabs button{padding:10px 1px 12px;background:none;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;color:var(--muted, #686b64);font:400 13px/1.5 var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--ink, #252724);border-color:var(--ink, #252724);font-weight:600}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #465c45);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:899px){.ds-tabs{padding:0 22px;gap:28px}.ds-tabs button{min-height:44px}}

components.name: Document row
components.description: Drawn icon, filename, secondary metadata and underlined actions without another nested card.
components.html:
Sample kitchen plan.pdf
PDF document
components.css: .ds-document{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:11px;min-width:205px;padding:8px 5px;color:var(--ink, #252724);font:400 15px/1.5 var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif)}.ds-doc-icon{flex:none;color:#636c5b;margin-top:3px}.ds-doc-main{min-width:0;flex:1}.ds-doc-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-doc-sub{font-size:12px;color:#62695c;margin-top:2px}.ds-doc-actions{display:flex;gap:15px;margin-top:7px;align-items:center;font-size:13px}.ds-doc-link{border:0;padding:0;background:none;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;color:var(--accent, #465c45);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}.ds-doc-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #465c45);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:899px){.ds-doc-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:36px}}

narrative.overview:
Off-white surfaces, charcoal typography and restrained navigation give customer conversations priority. Compact, controlled spacing supports daily work; subtle selections and a small set of meaningful colours make state visible without making the interface loud.

This documents the implemented plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript interface in `public/app.css` and `public/index.html`. The confirmed direction rejects gradients, nested cards, oversized controls and generic dashboard decoration. No new brand metaphor or business claim is implied.
keyCharacteristics: Light neutral surfaces and charcoal text.
Compact spacing and a clear name, message, metadata hierarchy.
Restrained navigation and subtle selected states.
Customer messages and media take visual priority.
Minimal borders and shadows, reserved for structural separation.

rules.name: The Sparse Colour Rule
rules.body: Use colour to communicate interaction, message direction or status; do not tint whole working areas for decoration.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Reserve elevation for an overlay that sits above another working surface.

dos: Do keep the workspace light, calm and compact.
Do give conversations, customer media and readable text priority over chrome.
Do use subtle fills for selection and sparse colour for meaningful state.
Do keep profile tabs stable and Save reachable while content scrolls.
Do preserve visible focus, useful labels and the implemented phone touch targets.
Do derive new styling from the frontmatter and current CSS before adding another token.
donts: Don't add gradients, decorative shadows or nested cards.
Don't enlarge routine controls or introduce generic dashboard decoration.
Don't turn future destinations into apparently working features.
Don't replace the existing messaging interface or alter backend contracts to implement a visual pattern.
Don't introduce a dark sidebar or apply the media viewer's dark scrim to the workspace.
Don't invent brand claims, metaphors, decorative imagery or new font dependencies.
